name: NASA
label: NASA
description: NASA official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: apod, neo_feed, neo_lookup, neo_browse, donki_cme, donki_flares, donki_notifications, epic (aliases neo, donki, earth_imagery). Docs: https://api.nasa.gov/. NASA Open APIs. Query api_key. DEMO_KEY is rate-limited. The Landsat Earth API and Mars Rover API are archived (Earth → Earthdata GIBS); earth_imagery here is a deprecated alias of epic (EPIC / DSCOVR), not the retired Earth API. NASA media guidelines. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One NASA request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"apod"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: apod | neo_feed | neo_lookup | neo_browse | donki_cme | donki_flares | donki_notifications | epic. Aliases kept for compatibility: neo (= neo_feed), donki (= donki_notifications), earth_imagery (= epic; not the archived Landsat Earth API). Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'apod'.

schema.label: asteroid_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `asteroid_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: endDate
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `endDate` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: end_date

schema.label: page
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `page` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: size

schema.label: startDate
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `startDate` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `type` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: apod | neo | donki | earth_imagery | neo_feed | neo_lookup | neo_browse | donki_cme | donki_flares | donki_notifications | epic. earth_imagery is a deprecated alias of epic (EPIC), not the archived Landsat Earth API. Example: 'apod'.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 30. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
